title: ZeRO: Memory Optimizations Toward Training Trillion Parameter Models
description: Standard data parallelism replicates optimizer states and gradients across every GPU — prohibitively expensive for large models. ZeRO partitions these across ranks: Stage 1 partitions optimizer states, Stage 2 adds gradients, Stage 3 adds parameters. ZeRO-3 enables trillion-parameter training on commodity GPU clusters and is the foundation of DeepSpeed.
